issues.description: Retry-After only accepts numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date values, falling back to the wrong delay.
backoff_cap is applied before jitter, so actual sleep duration can exceed the documented cap.
Retry/backoff configuration is not validated beyond max_attempts, allowing negative sleeps or nonsensical caps.
Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without URL-encoding, causing route confusion for IDs with reserved characters.
Successful response schemas are trusted without validation, so malformed 2xx responses raise raw KeyError/TypeError instead of a client error.
BatchItemResult does not validate status or task/error invariants, allowing impossible result objects.
ReviewResult.from_dict accepts arbitrary verdict strings despite the public Literal type.
The typed package does not ship a py.typed marker, so downstream type checkers may not consume its annotations as PEP 561 types.
Scripted mock responses bypass API-key validation, which can hide auth regressions in tests using enqueue_response.
